from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); manifest=json.loads((root/'snapshot.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(manifest['source_zip']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rows=[{'path':row['path'],'initial_sha256':row['sha256'],'final_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for row in manifest['files']]
for row in rows: row['unchanged']=row['initial_sha256']==row['final_sha256']
stable=all(row['unchanged'] for row in rows)
report={'source_zip':manifest['source_zip'],'final_zip_sha256':actual,'zip_matches':actual==manifest['expected_sha256'],'file_count':len(rows),'all_input_files_unchanged':stable,'files':rows}
(root/'input-stability.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('ZIP_SHA256='+actual); print('ZIP_MATCH='+str(report['zip_matches'])); print('INPUT_FILES='+str(len(rows))); print('ALL_INPUT_FILES_UNCHANGED='+str(stable))
raise SystemExit(0 if report['zip_matches'] and stable else 1)
